spec.name: Cyberpunk: Perk & Cyberware Skill Tree
spec.genInstructions: Build an interactive branching skill/perk tree grouped by the five attributes with unlockable nodes, spend-point interaction, tier gating, and cyberware slots. Users allocate perk points to boost V's capabilities.
spec.role: The character-progression surface where perk points are spent, gated by attribute levels from the HUD and pushing resulting stat bonuses back to it.

effectors.name: Cyberpunk: V Character HUD Panel
effectors.description: Receives V's current attribute levels and available perk-point count from the HUD; uses attribute levels to lock/unlock perk tiers and displays the remaining spendable points as the allocation budget.

targets.name: Cyberpunk: V Character HUD Panel
targets.description: When the user unlocks a perk node, emits the perk's stat bonuses (e.g. +health, +crit chance, +hack duration) and decrements the point pool; the HUD applies the bonuses to its stat displays and updates available points.

style:
- Outermost container: bg-neutral-950 with a subtle diagonal scanline overlay via bg-gradient-to-br from-neutral-950 via-black to-neutral-900; add relative-safe backdrop tint text-cyan-50
- Card/panel surface: bg-neutral-900/85 backdrop-blur-md with a top-edge accent via bg-gradient-to-b from-neutral-900/90 to-neutral-950/95
- Inset/recessed surface: bg-black/60 with inner shadow shadow-[inset_0_0_12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] and a faint cyan tint ring-1 ring-cyan-400/10
- Chip/tag surface: bg-neutral-800/70 backdrop-blur-sm
- Button surface (default): bg-neutral-800/80; primary action: bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 to-cyan-300 text-black; danger action: bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-500 to-red-600 text-white
- Panel border: border border-cyan-400/25 rounded-none (hard cyberpunk edges) — NEVER white; accent panels use border-yellow-300/40
- Input border: border border-cyan-400/30 rounded-sm bg-black/50 focus:border-cyan-300/70 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-300/40
- Button border: border border-cyan-300/40 rounded-none; primary button borderless (border-transparent); danger button border border-rose-400/50
- Chip border: border border-fuchsia-400/40 rounded-full
- Radius scale: panels rounded-none, inputs/inner-cards rounded-sm, chips rounded-full, badges rounded-sm
- Primary text: text-cyan-50
- Secondary text: text-cyan-200/70
- Muted/disabled text: text-neutral-500
- Primary accent fill: bg-cyan-400; accent text: text-cyan-300; accent border: border-cyan-400/50
- Secondary accent (progression/perks): text-fuchsia-400, bg-fuchsia-500, border-fuchsia-400/50
- Tertiary accent (map/quests): text-amber-300, bg-amber-400, border-amber-300/50
- Success: text-emerald-400 / bg-emerald-500; Warning: text-yellow-300 / bg-yellow-400; Danger: text-rose-500 / bg-rose-600
- Rarity tokens (inventory): common text-neutral-300/border-neutral-500, uncommon text-emerald-400/border-emerald-400, rare text-cyan-300/border-cyan-400, epic text-fuchsia-400/border-fuchsia-400, legendary text-amber-300/border-amber-300
- Font family (all UI): font-mono for a terminal/tech feel
- Display text (readouts, numerals, button/pad labels): font-mono font-bold tracking-widest uppercase, color text-cyan-300 (or matching accent per component); NEVER set a font-size on display text
- Headings: text-lg font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] leading-tight text-cyan-100
- Body: text-sm font-normal tracking-normal leading-relaxed text-cyan-100/90
- Labels: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] leading-none text-cyan-300/80
- Captions: text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.15em] leading-tight text-neutral-400
- Inter-component gap: gap-3
- Card padding: p-3
- Compact item padding: p-2
- Chip padding: px-2 py-1
- Button padding: px-3 py-2
- Header (chrome) height: h-9 — appearance: px-3, border-b border-cyan-400/25, bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500/15 via-neutral-900/80 to-transparent; title type text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-cyan-200
- Footer/status strip height: h-7 — appearance: px-3, border-t border-cyan-400/20, bg-black/70; text uses caption token with text-amber-300/70
- Elevation floating panels: shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(34,211,238,0.15)] plus shadow-xl; accent glow on active elements shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(232,121,249,0.5)]
- Flat/inset surfaces: shadow-none (rely on inner shadow)
- Progress/stat bars: track bg-black/60 border border-cyan-400/20; fill bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 to-cyan-200 with shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(34,211,238,0.6)]; armor fill from-amber-400 to-yellow-300; health fill from-rose-500 to-red-400; street-cred fill from-fuchsia-500 to-purple-400
- Base transition: transition-all duration-200 ease-out
- Button hover: hover:bg-cyan-300 hover:text-black hover:shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(34,211,238,0.5)] hover:border-cyan-200; active:scale-[0.97] active:brightness-110
- Primary button hover: hover:brightness-125 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(34,211,238,0.7)]
- Danger button hover: hover:brightness-125 hover:shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(244,63,94,0.6)]
- Row hover: hover:bg-cyan-400/10 hover:border-l-2 hover:border-cyan-400 transition-colors duration-150
- Interactive chip hover: hover:bg-fuchsia-500/25 hover:border-fuchsia-300 hover:text-fuchsia-200 transition-all duration-150
- Selected/active state: ring-1 ring-cyan-400/60 bg-cyan-400/10 text-cyan-200
- Locked/gated state: opacity-40 grayscale
- Marker/node pulse (map markers, unlockable perk nodes): animate-pulse with accent glow shadow
- Focus-visible on all interactives: focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-cyan-300/70

library.description: Framed avatar image display for a character, showing the supplied image source with an optional status/condition overlay.
Compact numeric badge rendering an integer rank/level value, optionally with progress toward the next level as a normalized 0-1 fraction.
Horizontal filled bar showing value within min..max (fill fraction = (value-min)/(max-min)); optional segmented rendering and optional overlaid numeric text.

Single label-free numeric or text readout of one datum (value given in its own unit as a number or preformatted string), with optional delta/modifier shown alongside; face content supplied via children.
Single unlockable skill-tree node button with rank state (current/max ranks), locked/unlockable/unlocked state driven by gating, and click to spend a point on it.
Single equip slot that displays the currently slotted item (or empty placeholder) and emits selection/clear actions for that slot.

props.item: { id: string; label: string; icon?: string; rarity?: string } | null

library.description: Momentary push button that fires once per press; face content supplied via children; supports disabled state.
Latching two-state switch; on reflects current state and onChange emits the new boolean state.
Floating info popover anchored to a hovered/focused element, rendering supplied content when open.
Segmented row of mutually exclusive category options; value is the selected option id and onChange emits the newly selected id.

props.options: { id: string; label: string; count?: number }[]

library.description: Single-line text input for filtering; value is the current query string and onChange emits each new query.
Grid-based selection of items rendered as tiles carrying icon, name, rarity, quantity and stat summary; value is the selected item id, onChange emits selection, onActivate emits use/equip of an item.

props.items: { id: string; label: string; icon?: string; rarity?: string; quantity?: number; stats?: { label: string; value: number | string }[]; equipped?: boolean }[]

library.description: Detail readout for one selected item showing its name, description, rarity and list of stat lines supplied as data.

props.item: { id: string; label: string; description?: string; rarity?: string; stats?: { label: string; value: number | string }[] } | null

library.description: Vertical selection list of multi-field entries (title, subtitle, category, status, optional nested children); value is the selected entry id, onChange emits selection, onActivate emits open/expand.

props.items: { id: string; label: string; subtitle?: string; category?: string; status?: string; children?: { id: string; label: string; done?: boolean }[] }[]

library.description: Ordered list of objective steps each with completion state, rendering progress through the sequence.

props.steps: { id: string; label: string; done: boolean; optional?: boolean }[]

library.description: Pan/zoom-able stylized map surface that renders supplied district regions and labels in normalized 0-1 map coordinates; emits view changes (center 0-1 coords and zoom factor).

props.regions: { id: string; label: string; path?: string; bounds?: { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number } }[]
props.onViewChange: (view: { center: { x: number; y: number }; zoom: number }) => void

library.description: Point marker positioned at normalized 0-1 map coordinates with a kind/state, emitting click and hover with its id.
Path overlay drawn across a map surface from an ordered list of normalized 0-1 waypoints, with optional distance readout.
Zoom stepper for a map view; value is the current zoom factor within min..max and onChange emits the new factor.
